search_results.title: Quantum Error Correction Hits New Milestone
search_results.snippet: Researchers report a breakthrough in fault-tolerant qubits, cutting the logical error rate by an order of magnitude using a new surface-code variant.

search_results.title: Startup Raises Funding For Quantum Chips
search_results.snippet: A new chipmaker closed a Series B funding round to scale production of superconducting qubit chips for enterprise customers.

search_results.title: Government Lab Opens Quantum Research Center
search_results.snippet: A national lab opened a dedicated quantum computing wing focused on materials science applications and workforce training.

search_results.title: Quantum Networking Demo Over 100km Fiber
search_results.snippet: A university team demonstrated entanglement distribution over 100 kilometers of standard telecom fiber, a step toward a quantum internet.
